fields.verdict: race/ethnicity: primary comparison (stratifier defensible); other roles as both readers
fields.why: Methods stratify every outcome by race, MSA, SVI and other characteristics alike (stratifier), but the Summary headlines lower coverage among Black and Hispanic persons and the Discussion gives racial disparities its own paragraph (primary comparison). The brief does not define where stratifier ends and primary comparison begins.

brief_issues: Equity dimension roles: no definition separating 'primary comparison' from 'stratifier' when an SPD is one of many stratifiers but is headlined in the Summary.
